body.statement: Determine the worst-case bit complexity of producing the certified width-\(\delta\) rational enclosure of \(B_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger\) from rational \(T\) and \(\varepsilon\). Establish either a polynomial bound in the binary input lengths, \(n\), and \(\log(1/\delta)\), or a matching obstruction for this exact eight-type orbit evaluator. The Handle is the signed-subresultant and comparison-node refinement scheme in \(\mathrm{def:algebraic-complexity-handle}\).
body.justification: Exactness alone does not quantify whether the cross-sample certificate can be generated at protocol scale; the arithmetic complexity is a distinct property of the new algebraic evaluator.
body.gap: The accepted parent gives rational same-sample programs and the two-arm comparators give asymptotic formulas, but neither analyzes ordered cubic-field comparisons across all three-arm allocation counts.
body.consumer: A reproducibility archive can state in advance the resources needed to certify a planned unequal-three-arm trial to a requested numerical tolerance.
